verses.arabicText: كٓهيعٓصٓ
verses.transliteration: Kaf-ha-ya-ain-sad
verses.translation: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.

verses.arabicText: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
verses.transliteration: Dhik'ru raḥmati rabbika ʿabdahu zakariyyā
verses.translation: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

verses.arabicText: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Idh nādā rabbahu nidāan khafiyyan
verses.translation: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-ish'taʿala r-rasu shaybaw-walam akun biduʿāika rabbi shaqiyyan
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-innī khif'tu l-mawāliya miw-warāī wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiran fahab lī mil-ladunka waliyyan
verses.translation: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

verses.arabicText: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yarithunī wayarithu min āli yaʿqūba wa-ij'ʿalhu rabbi raḍiyyan
verses.translation: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."

verses.arabicText: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yāzakariyyā innā nubashiruka bighulāmin us'muhu yaḥyā lam najʿal lahu min qablu samiyyan
verses.translation: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī ghulāmuw-wakānati im'ra-atī ʿāqiraw-waqad balaghtu mina l-kibari ʿitiyyan
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.transliteration: Qāla kadhālika qāla rabbuka huwa ʿalayya hayyinuw-waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan
verses.translation: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi ij'ʿal lī āyatan qāla āyatuka allā tukallima n-nāsa thalātha layālin sawiyyan
verses.translation: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."

verses.arabicText: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fakharaja ʿalā qawmihi mina l-miḥ'rābi fa-awḥā ilayhim an sabbiḥū buk'rataw-waʿashiyyan
verses.translation: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.

verses.arabicText: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yāyaḥyā khudhi l-kitāba biquwwatiw-waātaynāhu l-ḥuk'ma ṣabiyyan
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

verses.arabicText: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Waḥanānam-min ladunnā wazakataw-wakāna taqiyyan
verses.translation: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah

verses.arabicText: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wabarran biwālidayhi walam yakun jabbāran ʿaṣiyyan
verses.translation: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

verses.arabicText: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wasalāmun ʿalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamūtu wayawma yub'ʿathu ḥayyan
verses.translation: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi maryama idhi intabadhat min ahlihā makānan sharqiyyan
verses.translation: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

verses.arabicText: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-ittakhadhat min dūnihim ḥijāban fa-arsalnā ilayhā rūḥanā fatamathala lahā basharan sawiyyan
verses.translation: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

verses.arabicText: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qālat innī aʿūdhu bil-raḥmāni minka in kunta taqiyyan
verses.translation: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla innamā anā rasūlu rabbiki li-ahaba laki ghulāman zakiyyan
verses.translation: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."

verses.arabicText: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qālat annā yakūnu lī ghulāmuw-walam yamsasnī basharuw-walam aku baghiyyan
verses.translation: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla kadhāliki qāla rabbuki huwa ʿalayya hayyinuw-walinajʿalahu āyatal-lilnnāsi waraḥmatam-minnā wakāna amram-maqḍiyyan
verses.translation: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "

verses.arabicText: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Faḥamalathu fa-intabadhat bihi makānan qaṣiyyan
verses.translation: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

verses.arabicText: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-ajāahā l-makhāḍu ilā jidh'ʿi n-nakhlati qālat yālaytanī mittu qabla hādhā wakuntu nasyam-mansiyyan
verses.translation: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

verses.arabicText: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fanādāhā min taḥtihā allā taḥzanī qad jaʿala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyyan
verses.translation: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

verses.arabicText: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wahuzzī ilayki bijidh'ʿi n-nakhlati tusāqiṭ ʿalayki ruṭaban janiyyan
verses.translation: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

verses.arabicText: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fakulī wa-ish'rabī waqarrī ʿaynan fa-immā tarayinna mina l-bashari aḥadan faqūlī innī nadhartu lilrraḥmāni ṣawman falan ukallima l-yawma insiyyan
verses.translation: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

verses.arabicText: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-atat bihi qawmahā taḥmiluhu qālū yāmaryamu laqad ji'ti shayan fariyyan
verses.translation: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

verses.arabicText: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yāukh'ta hārūna mā kāna abūki im'ra-a sawiw-wamā kānat ummuki baghiyyan
verses.translation: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

verses.arabicText: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-ashārat ilayhi qālū kayfa nukallimu man kāna fī l-mahdi ṣabiyyan
verses.translation: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla innī ʿabdu l-lahi ātāniya l-kitāba wajaʿalanī nabiyyan
verses.translation: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalanī mubārakan ayna mā kuntu wa-awṣānī bil-ṣalati wal-zakati mā dum'tu ḥayyan
verses.translation: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

verses.arabicText: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wabarran biwālidatī walam yajʿalnī jabbāran shaqiyyan
verses.translation: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wal-salāmu ʿalayya yawma wulidttu wayawma amūtu wayawma ub'ʿathu ḥayyan
verses.translation: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

verses.arabicText: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūn
verses.translation: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

verses.arabicText: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.transliteration: Mā kāna lillahi ay-yattakhidha miw-waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūn
verses.translation: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭum-mus'taqīmun
verses.translation: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

verses.arabicText: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylul-lilladhīna kafarū mim-mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin
verses.translation: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

verses.arabicText: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini ẓ-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālim-mubīnin
verses.translation: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

verses.arabicText: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatiw-wahum lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan-nabiyyan
verses.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayan
verses.translation: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?

verses.arabicText: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan
verses.translation: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.

verses.arabicText: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yāabati lā taʿbudi sh-shayṭāna inna sh-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan
verses.translation: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.

verses.arabicText: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Yāabati innī akhāfu ay-yamassaka ʿadhābum-mina r-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan
verses.translation: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-il-lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyan
verses.translation: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyan
verses.translation: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

verses.arabicText: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyan
verses.translation: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan
verses.translation: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahum mir-raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyan
verses.translation: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣaw-wakāna rasūlan-nabiyyan
verses.translation: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

verses.arabicText: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wanādaynāhu min jānibi ṭ-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan
verses.translation: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahu mir-raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyan
verses.translation: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan-nabiyyan
verses.translation: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

verses.arabicText: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan
verses.translation: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan-nabiyyan
verses.translation: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

verses.arabicText: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
verses.transliteration: Warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan
verses.translation: And We raised him to a high station.

verses.arabicText: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
verses.transliteration: Ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina n-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥiw-wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu r-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadaw-wabukiyyan
verses.translation: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

verses.arabicText: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū ṣ-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū sh-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan
verses.translation: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.transliteration: Illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayan
verses.translation: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

verses.arabicText: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada r-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyan
verses.translation: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.

verses.arabicText: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāmaw-walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'rataw-waʿashiyyan
verses.translation: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

verses.arabicText: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan
verses.translation: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan
verses.translation: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -

verses.arabicText: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Rabbu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

verses.arabicText: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
verses.transliteration: Wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyan
verses.translation: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.transliteration: Awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayan
verses.translation: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

verses.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan
verses.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā r-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan
verses.translation: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyan
verses.translation: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

verses.arabicText: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-im-minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatmam-maqḍiyyan
verses.translation: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu ẓ-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan
verses.translation: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrum-maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan
verses.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthaw-wari'yan
verses.translation: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
verses.transliteration: Qul man kāna fī ḍ-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu r-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā s-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrum-makānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan
verses.translation: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

verses.arabicText: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudaw-wal-bāqiyātu ṣ-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawābaw-wakhayrun maraddan
verses.translation: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

verses.arabicText: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: Afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālaw-wawaladan
verses.translation: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"

verses.arabicText: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda r-raḥmāni ʿahdan
verses.translation: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

verses.arabicText: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddan
verses.translation: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.

verses.arabicText: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardan
verses.translation: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.

verses.arabicText: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatal-liyakūnū lahum ʿizzan
verses.translation: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

verses.arabicText: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
verses.transliteration: Kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan
verses.translation: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Alam tara annā arsalnā sh-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzan
verses.translation: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?

verses.arabicText: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan
verses.translation: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā r-raḥmāni wafdan
verses.translation: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

verses.arabicText: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dan
verses.translation: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

verses.arabicText: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Lā yamlikūna sh-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda r-raḥmāni ʿahdan
verses.translation: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: Waqālū ittakhadha r-raḥmānu waladan
verses.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Laqad ji'tum shayan iddan
verses.translation: You have done an atrocious thing.

verses.arabicText: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
verses.transliteration: Takādu s-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddan
verses.translation: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

verses.arabicText: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
verses.transliteration: An daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladan
verses.translation: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
verses.transliteration: Wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni ay-yattakhidha waladan
verses.translation: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

verses.arabicText: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
verses.transliteration: In kullu man fī s-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī r-raḥmāni ʿabdan
verses.translation: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan
verses.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

verses.arabicText: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
verses.transliteration: Wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardan
verses.translation: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu r-raḥmānu wuddan
verses.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
verses.transliteration: Fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawmal-luddan
verses.translation: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
verses.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zan
verses.translation: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
